proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Mass Heal has no attack roll and no saving throw — effects fire unconditionally on cast. The only ActivationPhase variants are attack_roll and save_gate; there is no variant for direct unconditional effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 Hit Points...

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.heal_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: Effect (used in spell phases) only has DamageEffect | NoneEffect. HealHpEffect exists in ClassFeatureEffect but is not part of the spell Effect union. Mass Heal's primary mechanic is healing HP.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.remove_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Mass Heal removes Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions from all creatures healed. The remove_condition atom exists in v4 but has no corresponding variant in the Effect type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Creatures healed by this spell also have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed from them.

proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection.any_number
proposed_widenings.justification: Mass Heal targets 'any number of creatures that you can see within range'. TargetSelection only has one and choose_up_to (capped by a SlotScaling). An uncapped 'any number' variant is missing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.pool
proposed_widenings.justification: The 700 HP is a flat integer pool allocated by the caster at will — no dice, no per-level scaling. DiceAmount requires dice (fixed DiceExpr, threshold_tiers, or linear_per_level). A pool variant with a flat cap and caster-chosen allocation is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose...

proposed_widenings.name: Condition extends blinded | deafened | poisoned
proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently limited to 'prone'. Mass Heal removes Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned — three conditions not yet in the Condition type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed from them.

notes: All six widenings are variants of existing surface types; no new v4 atoms are required (heal and remove_condition are both in v4 §9 Effect Atoms). The activation family is the right home once ActivationPhase gains a direct_effect variant. The pool mechanic (700 HP divided freely) is the least precedented shape — closest prior art is the choose_up_to target-count scaling, but the pool is over HP amounts rather than target counts.
